recommendation.text: The Board recommends that, involving local lawyers and considering all potential negative impacts, the Office review as to whether amendments/ clarifications on the warranty regime as set forth in the contract (including the conditions and the specifications) are deemed necessary and feasible. If so, the Office may wish to consider developing a clear and comprehensive warranty regime in a designated paragraph of the contract conditions or in a separate document.
